identityReference.description: Approved Slimeboss-chan idle identity drawing: lime-green long hair, tiny black bowler hat, gold-yellow eyes, black coat with white shoulder panels, slate tunic with a gold zip line, brown belt, grey trousers, tall brown boots, slime-glove fist and a small floating slime blob (generated, flattened on a dark background, not committed)

design.description: The user's Slimeboss-chan character design sheet: clean modern TV-anime linework and flat cel colour (style authority and identity; copyrighted/not ours to redistribute, not committed)

cards.scene: She swings her slime-glove fist in a wide backhand slap across the frame, a big arc of lime goop trailing behind it, a grey stone knight statue snapping sideways from the blow, a small slime blob swelling larger beside her shoulder.
A long glossy slime tongue unrolls from a small slime beside her and licks out toward a grey stone knight statue, while she gestures with two fingers like a conductor giving a quiet command.
She crosses her forearms in front of her chest as a thin translucent lime slime membrane forms a dome around her and glancing blows bounce off it in small flat sparks.
A clean straight punch: she drives her lime slime-glove fist toward the camera-right, three simple speed lines behind it, a flat white impact flash cracking a grey stone knight statue's round shield.

Low camera: she snaps two fingers and two slimes, one big and one small, shoot one after the other along a diagonal with trailing goop streaks and slam into the cracked shield of a grey stone knight statue.
She flicks one finger and a single round lime slime shoots like a cannonball into a heavy wooden door, planks splitting outward, her long hair streaming behind her.

A big slime leans forward like a wedge and bulldozes ahead pushing a grey stone knight statue backwards across the floor, while she walks calmly behind it with her coat flowing and a thin slime film hugging her shoulder as a shield.

A big slime rolls across a stone hall wrapped in bright yellow-lime flames and sweeps three grey stone statue silhouettes in a row at once, flame streaks and goop splashes, she watches from the side with her coat blown by the heat.
A slime lunges at a grey stone knight statue while she holds a fan of blank glowing cards in her other hand and one card dissolves into goop, a bright burst of lime energy leaping into her palm.

A huge slime slams down onto a grey stone knight statue with a big goop splash, and two smaller slimes beside her visibly swell twice their size with rising bubbles, her fist clenched in satisfaction.

A lead slime rams a grey stone knight statue while three fading after-image copies of it trail behind in a line like an unstoppable chain, she beckons forward with one raised finger and a bright motion streak runs through the frame.

A slime stretches itself into two sharp parallel goop spears that pierce straight through a round shield, one above the other, while she stands behind it with her arm extended forward and her hair swept back.
Three slimes in a row on a diagonal grow from small to medium to large, a thick slime wall bulging up behind her, and she rests a hand on the largest one with a faint smile.
A slime burst into droplets floats in the air and the droplets are pulled together above her open palm into a bigger glossy slime, shards of shine rippling inward, her eyes closed.
A small slime nibbles a glowing lime orb of food and swells a little, then licks the air happily, while she crouches next to it patting it with one finger as a gentle command.
She pulls two glowing blank cards out of a shimmering pool of goop with two fingers, eyes closed in recollection, a slime hovering calmly at her shoulder.
Five slimes of different sizes pile onto a grey stone knight statue in a squirming heap, goop dripping down, while she watches from the side with her arms crossed.
She sets a plate with a wobbling lime jelly dessert in front of a big slime at a candlelit table, a small slime waiting beside it with a tiny spoon of goop, warm calm lighting.
A slime dissolves into a bright glowing lime energy orb that she catches in her open palm, the leftover goop dripping away, her coat swaying.
A small slime latches onto a grey stone knight statue and a ribbon of glowing lime energy streams from the statue through the slime to her shoulder, a thin shield bubble flickering around her.

She sweeps her slime glove sideways and a wide fan of lime goop sprays across three grey stone statue silhouettes, the goop sagging heavily on them, while she flicks a glowing blank card from her other hand.
Centred emblem: her slime-glove fist clenched in front of her chest wrapped in jagged angry spikes of lime energy, hair whipping wildly, a bold ring of sharp zigzag energy around her.
She slides backwards low across a slick lime goop trail with one knee bent, leaving a long glossy streak behind her, while sword slashes whistle harmlessly over her hat.
Three slimes form a tight wall in front of her, the biggest in the middle, while arrows bounce off them, and she stands calmly behind peeking over the top with her tiny hat.
She bites a wobbling lime jelly snack on a stick with a relaxed smile while the biggest slime next to her bubbles up into a round shield bubble over her head.
She holds up a glowing blank card that is turning into lime candy between her fingers while a slime beside her swells in anticipation, a thin shield bubble around her, a faint smile.
One big slime splits in mid air into three equal slimes in a row, goop strands stretching between them, while she holds up her hand with fingers spread like a general.
A big translucent slime with a glowing blank card slowly dissolving inside its body and a bright orb forming within, while she watches it with her hands behind her back.
A rampart wall of tall stacked slimes spans the frame and she calmly looks over the top of the highest slime holding a small lantern, shine highlights on every blob.
Centred emblem: a gigantic slime hangs overhead against a dark ceiling about to drop, her small figure below looking up with one hand raised to hold it, a ring of dripping goop framing the scene.
A slime spits a ball of lime goop toward the camera in a splashy arc while she flicks a glowing blank card from her fingers, one eyebrow slightly raised.
From deep shadow a pale semi-transparent ghostly slime tongue licks out toward a grey stone statue, her silhouette half hidden in the dark with only her gold eyes and lime hair lit.
She chops downward with her slime glove stretched into a wide cleaver-shaped slime blade, goop chunks flying off a cracked grey stone knight statue.
A big slime completely smothers the head of a grey stone knight statue like a heavy blanket with goop dripping down, shaking lines around the statue, she holds one hand out calmly.
A slime dives from the top of the frame like a comet, stretched into a teardrop with a bright motion streak, and splashes into a grey stone statue in a ring of goop.
A big slime swallows a heap of glowing orbs of food, a round muscular bulge swelling in its body, while she watches with a content smile and a faint warm aura around the slime.
A long glossy slime tendril whips out of her slime glove like a tongue and wraps around the arm of a grey stone knight statue, while a small slime at her side glows a little brighter.
She and a slime throw a punch together side by side, her slime-glove fist next to the slime's fist-shaped pseudopod, both glowing brighter and lit by a bold flat colour burst behind them.
She relaxes in a wooden tub filled with glowing lime ooze, tiny bowler hat on her head, hair tied up, bubbles drifting, a small slime floating happily next to her, warm steam.
Centred emblem: a calm portrait of her with glossy lime slime armor plates covering her shoulders, forearms and gloves like layered pauldrons and gauntlets, a bright ring of goop behind her.
She lounges in a high-backed chair holding a teacup with one hand and waves the other toward a big slime that charges off at an enemy, a tidy slime shield bubble covering her chair.
She tosses glowing lime orbs of food from both hands to three slimes that rear up bigger as they eat, goop flying around, a grey stone knight statue knocked back by the swell.
She taps a big slime like a barrel with a wooden spigot and glowing lime liquid pours into a mug in her hand while sparks of energy and a card flutter out.
Centred emblem: she stands with her palm open to the sky while heavy glowing lime goop rain falls from a dark cloud above her in a ring of three bright droplets, hair and coat soaked in lime shine.
Centred emblem: she reads an open book with blank pages, one eyebrow raised, while a glowing card and a bright energy orb float out of the pages and a small slime peeks over her shoulder.
Centred emblem: two identical copies of her stand back to back, the second one drawn as a translucent lime afterimage, both with fists raised, a bright circle of light behind them.
Centred emblem: she sits on a tall slime throne with her legs crossed and conducts with one finger, small slimes lined up around her in neat formation, a bright lime halo behind her.
She strains with gritted teeth holding two glowing blank cards, her hair flying wildly, a lime aura bursting around her and two doubled after-images of her fist striking a statue at once.

She draws a glowing slime-shaped card from a floating deck of blank cards with two fingers while a perfect mirror copy of a slime appears in front of her, two identical slimes facing each other with a ring of shine between them.
Centred emblem: she stands back to back with one dark glossy lime slime, both in confident ready poses, fists touching in the middle, a circular glow behind them.
Centred emblem: she rises from the waist up out of a round lime puddle, her lower body flowing into the goop, three glowing lime cubes floating in a ring above her.
A wide shot with her pointing forward with one raised arm while a wave of a dozen slimes of all sizes surges behind her toward the camera like an army, her coat and hair blowing.

A huge slime hurtles along a diagonal as a spiked wrecking ball with thorny goop spikes and a trail of smaller tackle slimes lined behind it, smashing through a stone wall in a burst of rubble, she stands braced at the edge.
Centred emblem: a slime climbs a spiral of three glowing rings getting bigger at each ring, sparkles rising, while she lifts it with one open hand from below, a bright circular glow behind.
